The '''R-9 flash canister''' was a [[flash canister]] used in the training of [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentices]]. This explosive device would cause dozens of tiny shells within it to burst out and detonate in a flash of bright light, temporarily blinding those within the 4-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] blast radius.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual" />
